changes: Added a generic ClaimAdmissibilityPack TypeScript contract, a read-only in-memory pack registry, duplicate fail-closed validation, a built-in code-runtime pack descriptor, compatibility exports, and a focused smoke script/package target.
usage: Import from packages/main/src/core/evidence/admissibility/index.ts or packages/main/src/core/claim-admissibility/pack-framework.ts, then call listClaimAdmissibilityPacks(), getClaimAdmissibilityPack("code-runtime"), or validateClaimAdmissibilityPacks([...]). Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:claim-admissibility-pack-framework for the focused smoke.
expectedOutcome: The code-runtime pack validates as a ClaimAdmissibilityPack, duplicate ids and aliases are blocked, compatibility exports remain available, and no scientific truth, hardware, solver-improvement, production, or external completion claim is minted.
actualTranscript: Focused smoke printed: pack contract exposes code-runtime pack; duplicate pack ids: BLOCK; duplicate artifact aliases: BLOCK; compat entrypoint exports pack registry; claim-admissibility pack framework smoke passed. Full validate passed 31/31 and DONE-required validation passed 2/2.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference from the expected outcome; the runtime behavior matched the plan.
limitations: This story implements only the generic pack framework and code-runtime descriptor. Quantum/PINN verifier adapters, gate policies, benchmark harnesses, and reporting integrations remain separate future stories.
pitfalls: done_prepare merged main and changed materialHash while storyFilesHash stayed stable; delivery-check remained valid with advisory re-attestation text. The delivery reviewer initially refused because the prompt forbade git commits, but delivery_check_set correctly auto-commits Lattice metadata and was rerun with that gate-specific allowance.
